maps.name: Orchard Crossing
maps.description: Reveal a blossoming orchard, canal and village beyond a Ukrainian FPV. Watch the warned hunter and choose between the two offset exits.

maps.name: Courtyard Exits
maps.description: Reveal a sunlit rail-workshop courtyard through short, secured cuts. Two hunters commit to locked targets; choose another opening before they arrive.

maps.name: Night Crossfire
maps.description: Reveal a night canal and warm windows behind the crossfire. Watch the lane warning and keep a safe return path. The distant vehicles are illustration, not additional actors.

maps.name: Carpathian Woven Dawn
maps.description: Reveal a carved porch, woven blanket and misty mountain ridges. Two offset walls offer different exits from the warned hunter. The setting is an original interpretation, not a documented historic site.

maps.name: Petrykivka Sun Courtyard
maps.description: Reveal a bright courtyard and invented floral mural. Let a hunter commit before choosing another opening. The digital artwork interprets floral painting; it does not authenticate a traditional specimen.

maps.name: Dnipro Autumn Watch
maps.description: Reveal an autumn river, timber settlement and boats. Secure short cuts between lane warnings. Buildings and terrain are imaginative rather than an archaeological reconstruction.

maps.name: Midnight Arcade
maps.description: Reveal warm CRT cabinets and the cool street outside. Watch the hunter bracket, then pick an exit around the offset walls. Cabinet screens are static art, not interactive games.

maps.name: Rainy Video Rental
maps.description: Reveal a rainy shop, cassette case and neon reflections. Bait the locked interceptor and take a different opening. The rental covers and devices are invented and unbranded.

maps.name: Last Train, Side B
maps.description: Reveal a cassette player and a dusk train journey. Keep a return route between the lane warnings. The still picture contains no recorded song or moving train animation.

maps.name: Shared Value Harbor
maps.description: Reveal a fictional harbor and reusable supplies. Choose between two exits after the hunter locks its target. Decorative leaf emblems are invented; no Coupa logo, product capability or real savings are claimed.

maps.name: City of Small Wins
maps.description: Reveal a fictional planning instrument overlooking a connected city. Bait the interceptor before changing your route. The apparatus is an illustration, not software or a financial result.

maps.name: The Thoughtful Market
maps.description: Reveal a craft market, repair tools and shared materials. Secure your cut between the lane warnings. Score is a fictional arcade measure, not actual procurement savings.
